summary: States that sustainable tourism and investment in Toronto depends on neighborhoods being fortified and on workers having places to thrive.
source_quote: I care about attracting tourism and investment to this city, but that will only be sustainable if our neighborhoods are fortified and the hardworking people that keep this city running have their own places to thrive.

summary: States Toronto has the talent, resources, skills, and tenacity to compete with other world-class cities.
source_quote: We have the talent, resources, skills, and tenacity to compete with other world class cities. We are Toronto.

pledge_text: Will focus on protecting and growing 'main street energy' — thriving neighborhood hubs where people can afford to live, move safely, run businesses, and participate in institutions.
source_quote: One of my main areas of focus in this election is going to be protecting and growing our main street energy. That means thriving hubs where people are able to afford to live, to move around safely, to run their businesses, and to participate meaningfully in our institutions.
specifics: Stated priorities: affordability, safe mobility, support for local businesses, civic participation.

quote_text: One of my main areas of focus in this election is going to be protecting and growing our main street energy.
speaker: Sarah McVie

summary: States that democratic institutions are not listening and are performing for only a few.
source_quote: I know I'm not alone in feeling that our democratic institutions aren't listening, that they're performing for only a few.

summary: States she is running as a nonpartisan candidate and is not affiliated with any political party.
source_quote: I'm not affiliated with any political party. I'm running as a nonpartisan candidate.

pledge_text: Will reach out to Toronto residents over the summer to hear what they need and what is or isn't working.
specifics: Outreach over the summer; asking residents what they need, what's working, what isn't.
source_quote: Over the summer, I'll reach out to you. I wanna hear from you. If you live in Toronto, what do you need? What's working? What isn't?

pledge_text: Pledges to work toward rewriting the social contract and crafting a Toronto that is shared, thoughtful, beautiful, and just.
source_quote: rewriting the contract and crafting a Toronto that is shared, thoughtful, beautiful, and just

summary: Announced her campaign for Mayor of Toronto as a nonpartisan candidate.
source_quote: This announcement may surprise some of you. It may seem like a departure. It isn't. It's a distillation of everything I've worked toward.

quote_text: Let's craft a Toronto that's shared, thoughtful, beautiful, and just.
speaker: Sarah McVie

summary: States Toronto needs a new social contract that serves everyone rather than performing for a few.
source_quote: Toronto needs a new social contract - one that serves everyone instead of performing for only a few.

summary: Announced candidacy for Mayor of Toronto and launched campaign website mayormcvie.ca.
source_quote: I am running to be the next mayor of Toronto.

summary: States she is putting her artistic and teaching career on hold to run for mayor.
source_quote: I'm putting my artistic and teaching career on hold to work on a bigger social contract.

quote_text: Toronto needs a new social contract - one that serves everyone instead of performing for only a few.
speaker: Sarah McVie

quote_text: I am running to be the next mayor of Toronto.
speaker: Sarah McVie

summary: States that York South–Weston has long-standing flooding and sewage infrastructure problems, with one neighbour reporting issues since 1984.
source_quote: Sewage in the basement when it rains. 🫠 Turns out we've been living in an ongoing infrastructure horror show —I'm new to the cast but let me tell you this gig doesn't pay well at all! One of my neighbours has been reporting this issue to city officials since 1984

summary: States residents have experienced floods, property damage, and unmet commitments from elected officials.
source_quote: We've had floods, property damage, and broken promises from the folks elected to help.

summary: Encourages residents to organize with neighbours and demand better from government.
source_quote: may I recommend the #CoalitionLifestyle: meet your neighbours, demand better, and raise some polite but persistent hell.

summary: Co-founded the Black Creek Flood Coalition, starting with neighbour meetings in January 2025, to address flooding in York South–Weston.
source_quote: In January, a few of us started meeting. Now we've grown into the Black Creek Flood Coalition

summary: Delivered 200+ petition signatures to City Hall regarding Black Creek flooding; a councillor staffer received them and a second envelope was left for the Mayor.
source_quote: this week, we delivered 200+ petition signatures to City Hall. Did our councillor show up? Nope. But they sent a staffer, and we dropped the other envelope, addressed to our Mayor, in the lobby mailbox.

event_label: Delivery of Black Creek Flood Coalition petition to City Hall
source_quote: this week, we delivered 200+ petition signatures to City Hall

quote_text: meet your neighbours, demand better, and raise some polite but persistent hell.
speaker: Sarah McVie

summary: States the need to pivot to renewable energy and away from fossil fuel extraction.
source_quote: amplify a message about our need to pivot to renewable energy and away from fossil fuel extraction

summary: Opposes unsustainable production and extraction practices that degrade the planet for the enrichment of a few.
source_quote: FUCK THE DEGRADATION OF THE PLANET THROUGH UNSUSTAINABLE PRODUCTION AND EXTRACTION PRACTICES MEANT TO MAKE A FEW PEOPLE RICH

summary: Acted in satirical sketch comedy series 'The Big Oil Alliance' (ARCA Productions) playing a Chief Sustainability Officer, to amplify a climate/renewables message.
source_quote: The picture was taken at the launch party for The Big Oil Alliance. I play Amanda Green, Chief sustainability officer for a group of top oil companies

event_label: Launch party for The Big Oil Alliance (ARCA Productions sketch series)
source_quote: The picture was taken at the launch party for The Big Oil Alliance.
topic_focus: climate change / renewable energy advocacy via satire

summary: States support for arts funding and contributing to a healthy and inclusive arts scene.
source_quote: as someone who knows the power of creative work, both as participant and recipient, I feel honoured to contribute to a healthy and inclusive arts scene.

summary: Encourages spending money on works created by artists.
source_quote: Wherever you are in the world, I encourage you to go spend a little (or a lot) of money on something created by artists.
Got giddy with my glamorous gal pal Harmeet Bhatti at the #MayorsArtsEve in support of @torontoartsfoundation

summary: States that 235,000 people in Canada experience homelessness every year and signals concern about the issue.
source_quote: What I understand from those who know more about the issue is that 235,000 people in Canada experience it every year.

summary: Promoted Raising the Roof's #iGiveaDamn toque campaign to fund programs aimed at ending homelessness.
source_quote: If you're in the GTA look out for the good people from @raisingtheroof_cheztoit who will be selling these #iGiveaDamn #toques today at subway stations, in the PATH and at Nathan Phillips Square

summary: Launched the 25 Ward Tour, a citywide canvassing initiative featuring a game called 'Motion the Mayor'.
source_quote: The 25 Ward Tour is launched! Come join us for a round of Motion the Mayor, our canvassing game, or just share the municipal issues that matter most to you and ask questions about our campaign.
The 25 Ward Tour is launched! Come join us for a round of Motion the Mayor, our canvassing game, or just share the municipal issues that matter most to you and ask questions about our campaign.

Sarah McVie was gracious enough to invite me to her Mayoral kick off tour here in Ward 19. She shared her vision for the city... Thanks again to Sarah and her team for the invite and kind words. And thanks to Sarabeth of Red Tape Brewery for hosting.

pledge_text: Intends to visit all 25 wards of Toronto as part of a Ward Tour.
specifics: 25 Ward Tour, kicking off July 27 in Beaches-East York
source_quote: Yes I'm running for mayor of Toronto and I intend to visit all 25 wards!

event_label: 25 Ward Tour Kickoff Event with Mayor McVie
topic_focus: Campaign kickoff, canvassing game 'Motion the Mayor', and candidate Q&A

summary: States the mayor of Toronto has a duty to acknowledge and serve all residents, not just the powerful.
source_quote: The mayor of Toronto has a duty to acknowledge and serve all residents, not just the powerful ones.

summary: States that focusing on dignity for all will make housing, commutes, and public spaces safe for all.
source_quote: If we focus on dignity for all, we'll make our housing, commutes, and public spaces safe for all.

summary: Supports prioritizing under-serviced neighborhoods and improving service delivery everywhere.
source_quote: We start by prioritizing under serviced neighborhoods and improving service delivery everywhere.

pledge_text: Pledges to prioritize under-serviced neighborhoods and improve service delivery across Toronto.
source_quote: We start by prioritizing under serviced neighborhoods and improving service delivery everywhere.

pledge_text: Pledges to trust residents and build a Toronto that works for all.
source_quote: Let's trust the people that live here, and let's build a Toronto that works for all of us.

quote_text: The mayor of Toronto has a duty to acknowledge and serve all residents, not just the powerful ones.
speaker: Sarah McVie

summary: States that when systems neglect underserved residents, the dignity of the whole city suffers.
source_quote: When our systems neglect vast gaps of underserved residents the dignity of the whole city suffers.

summary: States that infrastructure and services should prioritize safety and dignity, with no one more deserving than anyone else.
source_quote: We all want infrastructure and services that prioritize safety and dignity, and no one is any more deserving of that than anyone else.

summary: States willingness to challenge waste and complacency at City Hall to make everyone safer.
source_quote: willing to challenge waste and complacency to make everyone safer

summary: States that her family's history in military service, diplomacy, and public sector leadership shaped her sense of duty to community.
source_quote: My family's history in military service, diplomacy, and public sector leadership raised me with a strong sense of duty and responsibility to community.

quote_text: When our systems neglect vast gaps of underserved residents the dignity of the whole city suffers.
speaker: Sarah McVie

summary: States that residents and ad hoc community coalitions across Toronto are already working to solve local problems and are tired of waiting for the city to respond.
source_quote: I know there are many other ad hoc coalitions all over Toronto that are resourceful, adaptive, and tired of waiting for the city to respond. As residents, we are experts with immense stakes

summary: States that solving Toronto's problems requires clarity about the obstacles preventing action, including roadblocks councillors may fear to name.
source_quote: the councillors that feel afraid to name the roadblocks preventing action. Toronto is a big city and if we're going to solve problems, we need clarity.

summary: States she and her neighbours have been working together to repair harm caused by irresponsible development.
source_quote: My neighbors and I have been working together to repair the harm of irresponsible development.

summary: Worked with neighbours to propose solutions, demand answers, educate one another on emergency procedures, and be accountable to each other in response to development impacts.
source_quote: My neighbors and I have been working together to repair the harm of irresponsible development. We've proposed solutions and demanded answers. We've educated one another on emergency procedures and been accountable to each other.

quote_text: Imagine the problems we would solve if we could clearly see all the obstacles.
speaker: Sarah McVie

summary: States Toronto needs clarity through improved public reporting tools, innovation in core services, and decentralized decision-making that returns power and resources to communities.
source_quote: I'm talking about improving public reporting tools, innovating core services, and decentralizing decision-making to put power and resources back in the hands of communities.

summary: States that failed democratic institutions have led to issues like flawed infrastructure planning and irresponsible development, where experts and organized citizens are ignored by the city.
source_quote: For years, I've been working on an issue in my community that is the result of failed democratic institutions... The experts write reports against it, but the city pushes on. Courageous citizens organize against it, but the city looks the other way.

summary: Describes her neighborhood as experiencing insufficient, flawed infrastructure planning.
source_quote: In my neighborhood, it's insufficient, flawed infrastructure planning. In your neighborhood, it's another form of irresponsible development.

pledge_text: Pledges to build a more responsive government together with Torontonians.
source_quote: One of the areas of focus in this campaign is making in of sure We are are Toronto in and together, we'll build a more responsive government.

pledge_text: Pledges to improve public reporting tools, innovate core services, and decentralize decision-making to communities.
specifics: improve public reporting tools; innovate core services; decentralize decision-making
source_quote: improving public reporting tools, innovating core services, and decentralizing decision-making to put power and resources back in the hands of communities

summary: States she has been working on a community issue tied to failed democratic institutions for years.
source_quote: For years, I've been working on an issue in my community that is the result of failed democratic institutions.
